title: moduleGroup
responsibility: Resolves a category from owned source paths and scores clear category matches.

inputs.name: modulePath.path
inputs.description: Workspace-relative module source path, optionally prefixed by its package path.

inputs.name: moduleGroup.paths
inputs.description: Owned source paths at the selected revision, including supported forwarding entries.

inputs.name: moduleGroup.groups
inputs.description: Validated project category definitions, including optional framework route-folder aliases.

inputs.name: matchingGroups.text
inputs.description: Code name and optional declared responsibility used for whole-word category matching.

inputs.name: matchingGroups.groups
inputs.description: Available project categories and the domain words each category matches.

outputs.name: moduleFolders
outputs.description: Immutable list of supported module roots preceding category folders.

outputs.name: modulePath
outputs.description: Scaffold root and remaining category/owner segments, or undefined outside supported module shapes.

outputs.name: moduleGroup
outputs.description: One category id and title from source folders or framework aliases; undefined when absent or conflicting.

outputs.name: matchingGroups
outputs.description: All categories tied for the best nonzero whole-word match; an empty array means no category matched.
